check_name: duplicate order_id rows
treatment: None found means no action; fct_orders asserts uniqueness

check_name: orders with no item rows (anti join)
treatment: Kept in order counts; seller and category are NULL

check_name: orders with no review (anti join)
treatment: Kept; review_score NULL, so they cannot trigger the low-review defect

check_name: orders with no payment row (anti join)
treatment: Kept; payment_value NULL

check_name: extra review rows beyond one per order
treatment: Latest answered review kept per order

check_name: review_id values shared by more than one row
treatment: review_id is not a key; never used as a join key

check_name: orders with more than one item line
treatment: Collapsed to one row per order in stg_order_items

check_name: orders with more than one seller
treatment: Primary seller = highest-value line; seller scorecard counts the order for each seller

check_name: status delivered but delivered date missing
treatment: Excluded from delivered population: lateness cannot be measured

check_name: status canceled but delivered date present
treatment: Treated as canceled; excluded from delivered population

check_name: status delivered, approval timestamp missing
treatment: Kept for breach metrics; approval lag and seller handoff NULL

check_name: status delivered, carrier date missing
treatment: Kept for breach metrics; handoff and transit NULL; unattributable in root cause

check_name: delivered before purchase
treatment: None found means no action; assertion in 03

check_name: approved before purchase
treatment: None found means no action

check_name: carrier pickup before approval (negative handoff)
treatment: Kept for breach metrics; seller handoff duration NULL

check_name: carrier pickup before purchase
treatment: Subset of negative handoff; same treatment

check_name: delivered to customer before carrier pickup (negative transit)
treatment: Kept for breach metrics; transit NULL; unattributable in root cause

check_name: estimated date with a non-midnight time
treatment: Zero rows: estimates are date-only, hence date-level lateness (see METRICS.md)

check_name: products with no category
treatment: Labelled unknown

check_name: geolocation rows outside Brazil bounding box
treatment: Dropped before taking the median per prefix

check_name: geolocation rows beyond one per zip prefix
treatment: Collapsed to one median point per prefix
